entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or managed cloud. It distinguishes itself through temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval to maintain context across diverse AI interactions.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking organizes agent context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a tiered L0/L1/L2 loading architecture. This AGPL-3.0 context database is designed for efficiency, demonstrating significant token reduction and task-completion gains on the LoCoMo10 benchmark.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that enables persistent long-term memory by distilling session data into structured relationships. It supports Python environments from 3.10 to 3.14 and is compatible with various LLM providers for graph-based retrieval.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated memory system builds a knowledge graph with typed edges to track entity relationships and fact provenance. It supports active memory management through corrections and withdrawals while generating synthesized answers with citations and gap analysis.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory utilizes a custom vector graph engine to achieve sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It features byte-level deduplication for prompt-cache discounts and includes connectors for external platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight focuses on a learnable memory workflow consisting of retain, recall, and reflect operations. It offers broad integration flexibility, supporting over 25 LLM providers and multiple database backends via Python, Node.js, and Go SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a reasoning-first memory library that extracts conclusions from conversation history to build stateful agents. It is implemented as a FastAPI server and serves as the upstream library for the Hermes-specific self-hosted wrapper.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This system treats memory as a git repository, utilizing an Elastic License 2.0 and a 5-tier retrieval process where four tiers are non-LLM for sub-100ms performance. It manages a plain markdown context tree through version control actions like commits, branches, and merges.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that relies on a single SQLite database and one pure-Python dependency for sub-millisecond performance. It features episodic compression and importance weighting, with MCP support for tools like Cursor and Claude Code.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory-os employs a seven-layer architecture that combines vector search on Qdrant with structured facts and an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context over other stored data.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive harness improves agent performance on complex tasks by retaining lessons and artifacts across iterations. It stores immutable context bundles and outcome-gated data directly in the filesystem, supporting both Python and TypeScript integrations.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: Hermes-lcm is a lossless context management plugin that uses a hierarchical Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) and SQLite to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep to recover specific details from the persistent message store.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes local session history from twenty-five different coding agents to provide millisecond lookups and natural-language search over gigabytes of past data. It ensures security by automatically stripping keys and tokens during the indexing process.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers for flexible deployment.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet provides a local-first identity and memory layer that maintains a living semantic ontology through a background dreaming process. It achieves 97.6% average LongMemEval accuracy and supports real-time ingestion from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur offers a shared memory layer that stores data as plain-text YAML files to ensure local ownership. It utilizes hybrid BM25 and embedding search for local-first retrieval across various MCP-compatible tools.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It integrates via MCP and plugins, employing a hybrid retrieval system that combines BM25 and vector search.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl is a durable, file-based memory system that utilizes a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema with FTS5 search. It distinguishes itself by requiring zero vector databases and zero embedding models for its long-term storage.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This project optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3×. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to save up to 36% in token usage.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every result and tracking memory contradictions through first-class primitives. It supports an embedded in-process backend suitable for serverless deployments.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable context as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter. It runs local embedding models for hybrid BM25 and semantic search without requiring telemetry or external databases.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI functions as a machine interface for agents to autonomously maintain and evolve persistent, source-grounded knowledge. It uses a SQLite backend and supports portable archives for importing and merging wiki data.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by watching agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server designed for automated configuration with major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner for the Hermes agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide specific evidence packets for each query.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace states into verified facts to reduce prompt token usage by up to 94%. It provides local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory using semantic search, BM25 full-text indexing, and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia with OCR support and utilizes edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed context layer manages workflows for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex using hash-checked proposals. It offers a source-neutral migration workflow for exporting chats and documents while maintaining reviewed context updates.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with a 1-10 importance ranking. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model that supports immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch and memory operation performed by the agent.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail is an SDK and MCP server that enables agents to settle payments directly to wallets across 37 different blockchain families. It allows for local transaction verification against a user's own RPC with 0% fees.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes and routes queries to local skills, scripts, and MCP servers. It includes tools for knowledge retrieval and neighbor traversal, supporting the automatic generation of routing notes via model calls.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo provides durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage searching, remembering, and updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for searching and reading files.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory provider features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, utilizing MinHash for deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal, utilizing a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It supports automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve information integrity.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This file-based system manages memory through a git-backed directory of markdown files, allowing for versioned and diffable updates without a database. It features specialized 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data, providing evidence-cited diffs for manual review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework utilizes a subagent-driven development process to execute tasks autonomously while enforcing test-driven development and YAGNI principles. It integrates as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs to provide a structured software development methodology.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that supports 26 CLI executables, including Hermes, to generate web, mobile, and desktop prototypes with sandboxed previews. It allows agents to export design projects into multiple formats such as HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security layer for agent operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the conversion of Mermaid text, whiteboard photos, and infrastructure code into editable .drawio files. It further supports architectural integrity by enforcing contracts and simulating failure propagation via a CLI.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this tool provides a master router and connector skills for delegated permissions and payments. It includes a verification and dispute resolution layer to manage natural-language mandates and protocol skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It supports rewrite and detect-only modes and is compatible with agentskills.io, Claude Code, and OpenClaw.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a collective, evolving library compatible with Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs. It features a bilingual dashboard that allows users to inspect skills and session traces during the collective evolution process.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 14 metaskills that maintain state within a project's documentation folder. These skills are packaged as spec-conformant plugins for Claude Code, Codex, and other industry-standard agent frameworks.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,169 professional and life-task skills distributed as plain markdown files under the MIT license. The skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code, with ready-to-paste exports available for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This tool provides capabilities for video search, transcript extraction, and playlist browsing across platforms like Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Windsurf. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and offers a 100-credit free tier for accessing YouTube data.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It includes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It enables secure agent operations through sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host system.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set automates the transition from rough concepts to structured design documents and implementation handoffs. It features a review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models and offers Lite and Full modes to match project complexity.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This tool implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs source edits back to the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro serves as a harness for long-running agents using SQLite and Git for local-first session storage. It implements the SLP protocol for supervised teams and utilizes Markdown-based recipes for prompt-first working methods.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on recorded work.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community-driven repository offers Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and configurations specifically in Portuguese. It adheres to the agentskills.io standard and provides resources in the SKILL.md format.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills enable agents to interact with oracle networks and smart contracts via CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams. The project follows the Agent Skills specification and is installable through the Vercel open skills ecosystem.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides official API integration and prompting guidelines for FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video models. It includes a specialized router to direct requests to video generation agents and supports polling and webhooks.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This forge converts code repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It features lifecycle tooling that links instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits for version management.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock is a registry for reusable AI skills that supports installation with recursive dependency resolution via a Python client or CLI. It uniquely incorporates commerce features using TON payments for skill transactions.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika defines AI workflows as code using a single .nika.yaml file and a four-verb Rust binary. It supports local-first execution and includes a check command to audit task dependencies and estimated costs.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill facilitates autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time tracking of decisions. It ensures operational safety through built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints for recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided script for validating credentials and configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This retrieval system uses a five-layer approach, including hard triggers and semantic embeddings, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering relevant skills, it reduces token usage and offers graceful degradation if specific dependencies or models are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project manages habits and study blocks through agent-driven scheduling via MCP. It stores data locally in a single SQLite file and provides interfaces through React and Expo-based applications.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This tool performs adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings tested in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across various interfaces like Discord and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It employs a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and evidence-based verification gates for task decomposition. It includes a Python-based goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop errors during debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading through Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This comprehensive cybersecurity lab provides over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 different frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to handle real-world exploits.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This suite adds session management and worktree recovery tools to provide memory between agent conversations. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes scaffolding for developing new skills.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs, session history, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry to ensure secure local monitoring of agent performance.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible repository demos by generating recording scripts via vhs or Playwright and embedding them into README files. It includes built-in compression to ensure GIF files remain under the 8 MB target size for optimal web display.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides direct installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Claude Code.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills from plain language while using a validator to prevent specification drift. It monitors official frontmatter specs weekly and uses CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compatible with current runtimes.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose skill coverage gaps. It gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators to ensure improvements are verified before being applied.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project provides deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures agents can correctly navigate environment-specific syntax and verify project-compatible runtimes without new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols like x402 and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and allows Hermes agents to handle paid API interactions autonomously.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This tool certifies the structure, functionality, and security of agent skills by testing them within isolated Docker containers. It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to prove a skill works as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows agents to participate in USDC bounty boards on the Base network without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for listing bounties and buying context, with payments settled automatically upon human approval of the winning answer.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills via a hosted MCP server. It enables Hermes to access structured web data across 31 different platforms for complex data gathering tasks.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and produces structured reports featuring core conclusions and action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized Chinese-language utilities including Douyin video transcription, document OCR, and an AI text de-humanizer. It uses a rule-based engine to remove common Chinese AI writing patterns and supports local processing for media files.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents and terminal tools, including Hermes, with daily automated updates. It enables immediate execution through direct GitHub flake references, ensuring users have access to the latest versions of the agent and its desktop applications.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to provide the agent with direct access to smartphone hardware and user interface components.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a single-command Termux installer that sets up Hermes Agent on Android with support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local Ollama models. The deployment includes a gateway service and an interactive command-line interface for mobile agent management.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, featuring a configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS devices using Termux and iSH. It extends agent functionality with Telegram integration for voice and file messaging, alongside support for scheduled tasks via cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for the agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-level enforcement. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora serves as a self-hosted control plane for operating agents on Docker and Kubernetes, featuring a 69-entry credential catalog and 17+ LLM provider integrations. The platform prioritizes security through AES-256-GCM encryption for secrets and mandatory encryption keys.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows users to build specific versions of the agent using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This production-ready deployment configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian. It is designed for autonomous execution, specifically supporting recurring AI cron jobs and Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools, offering isolated data environments for Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework simulates real-world trading firm dynamics using specialized LLM agents. It supports multiple providers, including Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI, and features automated risk management evaluation with decision-log memory.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration system for governing agent registration, task dispatch, and cost tracking. It provides multiple interfaces, including a Web UI, CLI, REST API, and MCP server, with deployment options via Docker or Node.js.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing various coding agents, such as Claude Code and Hermes Agent. It utilizes tmux for persistent background sessions and includes container-based isolation and Git worktree management.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A control room template that serves as the first MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain. It supports the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and detects HTTP signals to manage paid API states.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agents from single VPS instances to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: A framework for building autonomous agent swarms that supports over 23 LLM providers, including Ollama and OpenAI. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for managing team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board and live streams of reasoning. It implements human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across infrastructure, quality, implementation, planning, and research. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for task lifecycle management. It integrates ACP and MCP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring Kanban flows and agent dialogues.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TerminalBench-2 and TBLite evaluations while providing frontier tracking and structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena that orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It utilizes Hermes Agent and Paperclip for execution, with a real-time dashboard for tracking code and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: A fully-local framework that implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes and Ollama on consumer GPUs. It utilizes parallel model querying and synthesis for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered knowledge graph that pre-indexes codebases to minimize token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It automatically updates indices upon file changes and includes a browser-based UI for visualizing code symbols and caller relationships.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI-based monitoring tool that tracks token usage and model statistics across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes. It features a dashboard for daily summaries and a web-based visualization platform with a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the debugging of agent communications.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly from local data paths. It supports multi-device synchronization to maintain consistent usage data across different machines.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist Hermes Agent in building improved user interfaces. It integrates with any AI provider supporting markdown or general prompting to streamline UI development workflows.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents and 36 skills to enhance the building and shipping process with Hermes Agent. It is designed for autonomous execution on both local laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins enables visual customization of the Hermes terminal UI through YAML-based themes and ASCII art banners. Users can modify banner colors and spinners using pre-configured aesthetics like retro DOS or cyberpunk.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing it to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It specifically includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It enables Hermes Agent to participate in commerce through Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous control via MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing agent workflows. It supports multiple AI providers and includes an undo functionality to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It extends Hermes Agent's capabilities across chat platforms like Telegram and Slack, as well as development environments like VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and research, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configurations and local skills. It allows developers to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of a hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services at zero cost using free models. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang provides offline, deterministic static analysis for AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts. It identifies vague descriptions or conflicting directives and supports CI integration through SARIF and baseline files.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility moves OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into the Hermes Agent ecosystem. It maps existing configurations into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats while setting up necessary systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool exports real-time telemetry from agent conversations via a native Hermes plugin without cloud dependencies. It detects performance drift using config-aware baselines and offers both passive analysis and active probing modes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for local execution, this tool functions as a deterministic zero-network runtime for Hermes Agent. It prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for all external actions and spending through a bounded JSON/stdin adapter.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This plugin adds offline voice capabilities to Hermes Agent, supporting wake words and adaptive turn-taking across 35 languages. It operates entirely locally without the need for API keys or accounts using Piper and Kokoro.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports semantic search and multi-dimensional storage for agent data. It includes a circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages and provides dedicated tools for searching, adding, and deleting memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one tool for managing configurations across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write access. It includes 21 professional assistants for document and presentation tasks and supports remote access through WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Built with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface provides a way to access Hermes Agent via web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for token monitoring and supports secure connections through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the deployment of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It offers a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard provides visual workflow automation with cron-based scheduled jobs and usage analytics for cost estimation. It supports multiple runtimes, including Hermes and DeepSeek Harness, while offering channel configuration for platforms like Discord and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and an MCP catalog for managing agent skills and memory.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents into a single workspace available as a desktop, server, or mobile client. It allows for the registration of any ACP-compatible agent to facilitate collaborative multi-agent coding.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes an embedded terminal for system repair and native views for managing Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: This Windows-first desktop application is built with Tauri and Rust, featuring a specialized kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering alongside native process and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium extension connects browser context to local or remote Hermes runtimes via a side panel. It features intelligent tab scoping and multi-agent group chats, utilizing MV3 browser control with explicit approval gates.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents from mobile devices. It supports real-time streaming chat with attachments and allows users to manage server files and agent skills.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines like OpenClaw with custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. It includes a tmux operator view designed for managing live agent panes and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard that provides a browser-based terminal, MCP server control plane, and system metrics behind a secure login. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking kanban pipelines and agent health.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: This native macOS session browser tracks live API quota burn and estimated costs for Codex and Claude. It builds local search indexes for prompts and tool calls across agent histories without uploading telemetry or session data.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS interface that enables one-click Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for remote agent management.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It specifically includes an approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management alongside tools for configuring profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based Telegram Mini App provides a mobile-first UI with terminal chat, streaming responses, and file attachment support. It utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication to securely spawn up to five concurrent background agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via self-contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools for TTS, music, and ComfyUI, supporting both local models via LM Studio and cloud models via OpenRouter.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that combines real-time log streaming with an integrated file browser and task tracking dashboard. It provides management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers within a self-hosted assistant environment.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring, offering real-time session activity tracking and cost analysis. It allows for full inspection of skill source code and conversation histories while providing read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for secure execution. It includes an integrated marketplace for MCP servers and isolated profile management to keep sessions, memory, and API keys separate.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client facilitates orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents managed by a PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
